description: A conditional declaration that holds enables its feature for its own stage (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes ∩ A ≠ ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A

```
